blurb: Linden Place is a historic estate museum and arts center that tells one family's 200-year journey through American History. The 1810 Federal-period mansion and accompanying ballroom, sculpture garden, and outbuildings were built by one of America's wealthiest and most influential families. They were slave traders, merchants, tycoons and artists.
